title: Registry Permission Boundary - startupPrograms Tool
problem: startupPrograms command fails with access denied when reading HKLM registry. Requires administrator privileges or SeLoadDriverPrivilege
evidence: Error: Access to the registry path is not allowed
Tool succeeds when run as Administrator
Environmental issue: permission boundary affects visibility
cause: Registry HKLM (HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE) hive requires elevated privileges for full read access. User context lacks sufficient permissions

recommended_actions.action: Document registry access requirements in tool documentation
Add permission check before registry query with clear error message
Provide fallback: read HKCU (current user) registry as alternative

notes: Environmental constraint, not framework bug. Similar to IC-002 privilege boundary issue
